title: A very good experience
text: Our host was very nice and competent; she guided us without doing it for us, and we left very proud of our "work."
author: patriciabR8506BL

title: Fun workshop; adorable dog :-)
text: I chose to make a mosaic tile and was able to create my own design with help and guidance.  There were abundant materials to choose from and instruction about all the tools.  My instructor was patient, kind, and friendly, and had a beautiful dog! I had a wonderful time!
author: Aegin

title: Fun activity in the historic Ceramic sector of Seville
text: Very informative and fun experience! We were able to take a look at other pieces that were commissioned by this workshop. The owner was very friendly and explained the entire process of our activity. We would highly recommend anyone to do this experience as well!
author: Sumeet_G

title: Fun experience
text: A very nice experience! Not only is it a beautiful reminder of the activity, but you also go home with a unique souvenir that you made yourself. The trainer was very friendly, patient and helpful. She took the time to explain everything clearly and was always ready to answer questions. This made the workshop feel relaxed and accessible, also for beginners. Definitely recommended!
author: Explorer13370143721

title: Art and Conversation.
text: A lovely time learning an ancient art and visiting with Beatriz, the friendly proprietor. great local experience.
author: teri_r

title: AWESOME TIME
text: I had an amazing time! Beatriz is a kind teacher who knows so many languages!! She will be able to help you with all types of cerámica.
author: 100myab

title: Excellente!
text: The ceramics class was enjoyable with options for what we could create. The class was individual tables rather than group…very fun!
author: Len P

title: Fun, interesting and learning something new.
text: I recently took this ceramics class in Seville and had such a lovely experience. Beatriz, the teacher, was incredibly knowledgeable and made the session engaging from start to finish. She explained each technique clearly and with real enthusiasm, which made learning something new feel both fun and accessible. A wonderful way to spend time in the city and come away with a handmade piece and new skills.
author: Christina D

text: It met expectations 100%. We made some mosaics, the teacher knew how to explain everything very patiently.
